buildings.academy.label: Preaching Hall
buildings.academy.desc: The Great-Derivation pavilion that chars spirit timber into profound coal. Exclusively produces Profound Coal (+0.018/tick base).
buildings.academy.flavor: Curiosity is the basis of science. Our cats died nobly
buildings.accelerator.label: Star River Array
buildings.accelerator.desc: A magnetic aurora array that unseals ancient ruins. Exclusively produces Ancient Relics (+0.018/tick base).
buildings.accelerator.desc2: Storage bonuses remain effective even if powered off.
buildings.aicore.label: Artifact Spirit Core
buildings.aicore.desc: FelineOS, a state of the art artificial intelligence. Absolutely harmless. Every level of upgrade will increase Core energy consumption by 75%.
buildings.aicore.flavor: I think we can purr our differences behind us. For science.
buildings.amphitheatre.label: Dao Forum
buildings.amphitheatre.desc: A stage for immortal ballads. Produces culture and raises its cap
buildings.amphitheatre.flavor: Daily 'All Dogs Go to Heaven' showings
buildings.aqueduct.label: Spirit Canal
buildings.barn.label: Granary
buildings.barn.desc: A treasury inscribed with Sumeru containment wards. Exclusively produces Dao Scriptures (+0.018/tick base) and expands storage.
buildings.barn.flavor: Rats ain't a problem for us!
buildings.biolab.label: Herb Garden
buildings.biolab.desc: A warded herb garden drawing spirit-vein nectar from the earth. Exclusively produces Spirit Liquid (+0.03/tick base).
buildings.broadcasttower.label: Message Tower
buildings.broadcasttower.desc: Broadcasts far and wide—produces culture and raises its cap, boosted by surplus energy
buildings.calciner.label: Metal Calciner
buildings.calciner.desc: A highly effective source of metal. Consumes 1.5 spirit stones and 0.02 oil per tick. Produces iron and a small amount of Gengjin
buildings.calciner.desc.automation: Automation converts {0}% of iron output into steel.
buildings.chapel.label: Offering Hall
buildings.chapel.desc: Produces a bit of culture and faith per tick. May be improved with religious upgrades
buildings.chronosphere.label: Reincarnation Hall
buildings.chronosphere.desc: A wheel of time forged from True-Word laws. Exclusively produces Time Crystals (+0.015/tick base).
buildings.dataCenter.label: Jade Slip Vault
buildings.dataCenter.desc: An astral computation pavilion. Exclusively produces Insight (+0.025/tick base).
buildings.factory.label: Puppet Workshop
buildings.factory.desc.automation: Automation cleans pollution from the air.
buildings.field.label: Spirit Field
buildings.field.desc: Open spirit fields to cultivate yellow-sprout spirit grain. Exclusively produces Spirit Grain (+0.12/tick base; +50% in Spring, -75% in Winter).
buildings.field.flavor: 'Nip as far as the eye can see.
buildings.gatherCatnip.label: Gather spirit grain
buildings.gatherCatnip.desc: Gather some spirit grain in the woods
buildings.harbor.label: Spirit Boat Dock
buildings.harbor.desc: Provides a space to store your resources
buildings.hut.label: Thatched Hut
buildings.hut.desc: Build a quiet bamboo meditation hut in Shenshou Valley. Exclusively produces Cultivation (+0.005/tick base).
buildings.hydroplant.label: Water Spirit Array
buildings.hydroplant.desc: A modern source of power production
buildings.ivoryTemple.label: Bone Shrine
buildings.ivoryTemple.desc: A mystic shrine refining spirit bones into spirit stones
buildings.library.label: Scripture Pavilion
buildings.library.desc: A grand pavilion of jade slips and scriptures. Exclusively produces Insight (+0.006/tick base; +0.025/tick when upgraded).
buildings.logHouse.label: Spiritwood Lodge
buildings.logHouse.desc: A stone chamber carved into the Taiyue cliffs that nurtures spirit timber. Exclusively produces Spirit Wood (+0.035/tick base).
buildings.lumberMill.label: Spiritwood Mill
buildings.lumberMill.desc: Produces wood passively and increases wood output by 10%
buildings.magneto.label: Qi Gathering Pile
buildings.magneto.desc: An inverted Five-Elements array drawing heavenly lightning into crystal. Exclusively produces Purple Thunder Crystal (+0.02/tick base).
buildings.mansion.label: Manor
buildings.mansion.desc: An exalted cave-mansion modeled after Star Palace. Exclusively produces Mythril (+0.015/tick base).
buildings.mine.label: Spirit Stone Mine
buildings.mine.desc: Delve deep into the Taiyue mountain veins. Exclusively produces Spirit Stones (+0.05/tick base).
buildings.mint.label: Spirit Mint
buildings.mint.desc: Produces luxurious resources proportional to your max catpower. Consumes catpower and a bit of gold.
buildings.observatory.label: Star Observatory
buildings.observatory.desc: A high-peak astrolabe platform charting the stars of the Chaotic Star Sea. Exclusively produces Starcharts (+0.008/tick base).
buildings.observatory.flavor: Yearning to one day catch the red light fairy
buildings.oilWell.label: Earthfire Spring
buildings.oilWell.desc: Produces a bit of oil, +1500 to maximum oil limit
buildings.oilWell.desc.automation: Automation consumes energy for more oil production.
buildings.oilWell.flavor: Rise early, work hard, strike oil.
buildings.pasture.label: Beast Pen
buildings.pasture.desc: Provides an alternative source of food, which reduces spirit grain consumption.
buildings.pasture.flavor: Take a pint o' milk, Sir!
buildings.quarry.label: Darkstone Quarry
buildings.quarry.desc: Quarries each improve your mining efficiency by 35% and produce a bit of coal
buildings.quarry.flavor: It's full of mice! Wait, wrong 'quarry'
buildings.reactor.label: Earthfire Array
buildings.reactor.desc: A grand array fusing Azure Ice Flame and earth fire. Exclusively produces Void Immortal Gold (+0.025/tick base).
buildings.reactor.desc.automation: Automation consumes Violet Thundercrystal to produce more energy.
buildings.reactor.flavor: Glowing mice are much easier to catch!
buildings.refineCatnip.label: Refine spiritwood
buildings.refineCatnip.desc: Refine spirit grain into spirit grain wood
buildings.smelter.label: Artifact Forge
buildings.smelter.desc: Channel earth-lung true fire into the forging chambers. Exclusively produces Gold Essence (+0.008/tick base).
buildings.smelter.flavor: Pure flame yields pure dark iron.
buildings.solarfarm.label: Qi Gathering Array
buildings.solarfarm.desc: Provides an additional source of energy depending on the seasons.
buildings.spaceport.label: Starport
buildings.spaceport.desc: Increases the storage capacity of buildings in space. Does not affect science or Annihilation Essence.
buildings.spaceport.flavor: I want the fancy yarn imported from Yarn.
buildings.steamworks.label: Mechanism Hub
buildings.steamworks.desc: When active, significantly reduces your coal production. Does nothing useful by default, but can do a lot of cool stuff once upgraded.
buildings.steamworks.desc.automation: Automation crafts some materials if they're at the limit.
buildings.steamworks.flavor: I just nap here and it looks like I'm working
buildings.brewery.label: Spirit Brewery
buildings.brewery.desc: Brew spirit grain into a spicy drink. Boosts festival effects.
buildings.brewery.flavor: Sir! Want some nip' in ya milk?
buildings.temple.label: Ancestor Shrine
buildings.temple.desc: An ancient altar inscribed with divine runes. Exclusively produces Faith (+0.04/tick base).
buildings.tradepost.label: Trading Post
buildings.tradepost.desc: The heart of your trading empire. Improves trade effectiveness by 1.5%, reduces rare resource consumption by 4%
buildings.unicornPasture.label: Qilin Garden
buildings.unicornPasture.desc: Allows the taming of qilins. Reduces spirit grain consumption by 0.15%
buildings.warehouse.label: Sumeru Storehouse
buildings.warehouse.desc: Provides a space to store your resources
buildings.workshop.label: Artisan Hall
buildings.workshop.desc: The Hundred-Arts workshop that tempers profound iron. Exclusively produces Profound Iron (+0.018/tick base) and unlocks Workshop crafting.
buildings.zebraForge.label: Cloudsteed Forge
buildings.zebraForge.desc: Unlocks the craft of bloodstones and t-mythril.
buildings.zebraOutpost.label: Cloudsteed Outpost
buildings.zebraOutpost.desc: Provides a base for the hunting expeditions. Every level of upgrade improves expedition effectiveness by 5%
buildings.zebraWorkshop.label: Cloudsteed Workshop

buildings.ziggurat.desc:

science.acoustics.label: Acoustics
science.acoustics.desc: Acoustics is the study of sound. Though not obviously useful, in a long run it may benefit civilizations thriving for cultural and religious development.
science.advExogeology.label: Exometallurgy
science.advExogeology.desc: Exometallurgy studies new methods of Void-Gold processing
science.agriculture.label: Spirit Farming
science.agriculture.desc: The basis of all civilised life, Agriculture allows the working of land for food. Agriculture can significantly improve your food production.
science.ai.label: Heavenly Computation
science.ai.desc: A nascent mind that computes all things
science.animal.label: Animal Husbandry
science.animal.desc: Domestication allows access to various animal resources via the pasture. Improves your food production.
science.antimatter.label: Voiddust
science.antimatter.desc: Dust that annihilates — enough to burn a starfield
science.antimatter.effectDesc: Unlocks Voiddust Reactors, Voiddust Bases and the Voiddust Drive
science.archeology.label: Geology
science.archeology.desc: The lore of ancient strata — aids mining
science.archeology.flavor: Different fossils of giant lizards were discovered. Apparently they all died in a sudden but inevitable betrayal.
science.archery.label: Archery Arts
science.archery.effectDesc: Unlocks cloudsteed outposts and related buildings
science.architecture.label: Architecture
science.architecture.desc: Architecture allows construction of some new sophisticated structures.
science.architecture.flavor: A tower tall enough to pluck the stars
science.astronomy.label: Astronomy
science.astronomy.desc: Astronomy is the study of objects in space. Improves scientific development.
science.artificialGravity.label: Gravity Command
science.artificialGravity.desc: Commanding the void — a new art of ark travel
science.biochemistry.label: Vitae Alchemy
science.biochemistry.desc: The study of living matter and remedies
science.biochemistry.flavor: Some of the things that molecules do.
science.biology.label: Biology
science.biology.desc: Biology deals with living organisms, their characteristics and their use in our society. Improves science and chemistry industry.
science.biology.flavor: The secrets of evolution are time and death
science.blackchain.label: Darkchain
science.blackchain.desc: A ledger in dark crystal, indelible for aeons
science.brewery.label: Spirit grain Processing
science.brewery.desc: Spirit grain Processing is a non-mandatory technology which improves the process of converting spirit grain to spirit grain wood.
science.calendar.label: Calendar
science.calendar.desc: Develops the ability to predict when the seasons will change. This ability is essential for advanced agriculture.
science.calendar.effectDesc: Calendar provides a way of more precise time tracking
science.chemistry.label: Alchemy
science.chemistry.desc: The discovery of Chemistry allows the deeper study and understanding of natural elements and their interaction. As a result new resources may be unlocked.
science.chronophysics.label: Chronosophy
science.chronophysics.desc: The study of time's essence and its manipulation
science.chronophysics.effectDesc: Unlocks Reincarnation Halls, Flux Reactors and Stasis Chambers
science.civil.label: Civil Service
science.civil.desc: Establish rules to govern the estate
science.combustion.label: Ember Scripture
science.combustion.desc: Ember arts improve old mechanism pivotwork driven by dark coal, such as the mechanism pivotworks hub
science.combustion.effectDesc: Unlocks spirit-rune press, essence refining and ember injectors
science.construction.label: Construction
science.construction.desc: Construction represents the advancement of the study of masonry, primarily by adding iron and other metals to the builder's toolbox. Benefits hunting and base infrastructure.
science.construction.effectDesc: Allows your workers to construct the Lumber mill. Unlocks Composite Bows
science.cryptotheology.label: Cryptotheology
science.cryptotheology.desc: Cryptotheology applies the most arcane and unorthodox methods of theology in order to answer the fundamental questions of the universe and reality.
science.cryptotheology.effectDesc: Unlocks Relic Station and Cryptotheology tree
science.currency.label: Currency
science.currency.desc: Currency represents a certain amount of wealth. Can significantly boost your development in indirect ways.
science.dimensionalPhysics.label: Dimensional Lore
science.dimensionalPhysics.desc: Inquiry into the nature of space and time
science.dimensionalPhysics.effectDesc: Unlocks spirit-void rifts and the starriver array
science.drama.label: Drama and Poetry
science.drama.desc: Drama and poetry are both forms of artistic expression. Improves cultural progress.
science.ecology.label: Ecology
science.ecology.desc: Ecology is a technology primarily focused on the search for new cheap and safe energy sources.
science.electricity.label: Thunder Calling
science.electricity.desc: Electricity unlocks a new way to automate production, benefiting the catkind in all different areas.
science.electricity.flavor: Who knew running around on the carpet could generate such power?
science.electronics.label: Sigil Circuitry
science.electronics.desc: The art of circuits etched in runes and spirit crystal
science.electronics.effectDesc: Unlocks broadcast towers, diagram computation, frostjade cellars and the skyward array
science.engineering.label: Engineering Arts
science.engineering.desc: The art of structures, arrays and mechanisms
science.exogeology.label: Exogeology
science.exogeology.desc: The study of metals and spirit stones beyond the realm
science.exogeophysics.label: Exo-Geomancy
science.genetics.label: Genetics
science.genetics.desc: Technology that further improves upon biology and chemistry. Affects your food industry.
science.genetics.flavor: There's an unbroken thread that stretches from those first cats to us.
science.hydroponics.label: Spirit Cultivation
science.industrialization.label: Mass Production
science.industrialization.desc: Mass production of goods, from grain to automata
science.industrialization.effectDesc: Unlocks grand automation and canal barges
science.machinery.label: Mechanism Arts
science.machinery.desc: Previous advances in metal working and science give birth to the concept of a machine, a device with multiple moving parts. Machinery introduces a concept of automation which reduces routine operations
science.machinery.effectDesc: Unlocks Steamworks, Crossbows, Printing Press and Factory Automation.
science.math.label: Mathematics
science.math.desc: Mathematics is the most basic building block upon which all physical science is based. Improves scientific development.
science.math.effectDesc: Allows construction of Academies, very efficient research buildings
science.math.flavor: Purr equals Meow times Paw to the square
science.mechanization.label: Mechanization
science.mechanization.desc: Automating labor with mechanisms — crafting, wells and construction
science.mechanization.effectDesc: Unlocks automaton works, spring mechanisms and adamantite
science.metal.label: Forging Arts
science.metal.desc: The first metal-working technology that provides your civilisation with sturdy, durable tools.
science.metal.effectDesc: You can construct Smelters that convert ore into metal
science.metalurgy.label: Metallurgy
science.metalurgy.desc: Refines blackiron smelting; smelters and calciners improve
science.metaphysics.label: Metaphysics
science.metaphysics.desc: Metaphysics is a traditional branch of philosophy concerned with explaining the fundamental nature of being and the world that encompasses it. Absolutely useless.
science.mining.label: Ore Seeking
science.mining.desc: Mining develops the ability to extract mineral resources from the bowels of Cath.
science.mining.flavor: Pickaxes are easier to hold with opposable thumbs
science.nanotechnology.label: Micromancy
science.nanotechnology.desc: Weaving matter at the smallest scale
science.nanotechnology.effectDesc: Unlocks starforged robes, ninefold kiln, tempering and solar attunement
science.navigation.label: Navigation
science.navigation.desc:
Navigation allows serious advancements in sailing and shipbuilding technology. It should benefit economical development and can lead to discovery of new civilizations.
(Hint: You don't need to have all of this culture at once)
science.navigation.effectDesc: Unlocks the construction of Trade Ships and overseas trade.
science.nuclearFission.label: Thunderspark Fission
science.nuclearFission.desc: Harness split thunder-marrow; unlocks pyro arrays
science.nuclearFission.effectDesc: Unlocks pyro array and thunderspark steelworks
science.oilProcessing.label: Oil Processing
science.oilProcessing.desc: Unlocks advanced options of oil processing
science.oilProcessing.effectDesc: Unlocks spirit marrow and factory processing
science.orbitalEngineering.label: Orbital Engineering
science.orbitalEngineering.effectDesc: Unlocks the starport and star navigation
science.paradoxalKnowledge.label: Paradox Theory
science.paradoxalKnowledge.desc: Develop a framework for understanding and controlling the time-space continuum.
science.paradoxalKnowledge.flavor: Knock that bowl off your grand-beast's table for fun and profit.
science.particlePhysics.label: Mote Philosophy
science.particlePhysics.desc: Peering deeper into matter and energy than before
science.particlePhysics.effectDesc: Unlocks the starriver array, thundergun and crystal refining
science.particlePhysics.flavor: Mewtrinos are strongly and electrically aloof.
science.philosophy.label: Dao Inquiry
science.philosophy.desc: Philosophy is the first abstract science developed by catkind. Philosophy is a basis of spiritual and cultural progress.
science.physics.label: Physics
science.physics.desc: Physics is a study of laws of nature. Mostly improves your machinery effectiveness.
science.quantumCryptography.label: Quantum Cryptography
science.robotics.label: Automaton Craft
science.robotics.desc: Crafting automatons that labor in your stead
science.rocketry.label: Starcraft
science.rocketry.desc: Riding arks into the void — the dawn of starfaring
science.rocketry.effectDesc: Unlocks ark construction and essence processing
science.sattelites.label: Starhubs
science.sattelites.desc: Permanent arrays hanging in the celestial轨道
science.sattelites.flavor: Spreading beast videos at the speed of light
science.steel.label: Steel
science.steel.desc: Development of the new Steel alloy advances further metal working. Benefits most of the aspects of development.
science.superconductors.label: Superconductors
science.superconductors.desc: Superconductors are exotic materials that help to optimize energy efficiency of different technologies
science.superconductors.effectDesc: Unlocks coldmarrow fusion and celestial crafting
science.tachyonTheory.label: Aeonglow Theory
science.tachyonTheory.desc: Particles forever outrunning the light of ages
science.tachyonTheory.effectDesc: Unlocks aeonglow arrays and the chronoforge
science.terraformation.label: Terraforming
science.terraformation.desc: Reshaping the heavens of the starfield with voiddust
science.theology.label: Ritual Canon
science.theology.desc:
Theology is the study of religion. Religion is a key concept affecting cultural, scientific and industrial development.
(Hint: You don't need to have all of this culture at once)
science.theology.flavor: What is that flaming ball in the sky anyway?
science.thorium.label: Purple Thunder
science.thorium.desc: Purple thunder crystal — potent fuel for the starfaring age
science.thorium.effectDesc: Unlocks purple-thunder cores and the purple-thunder drive
science.voidSpace.label: Void Space
science.writing.label: Talisman Script
science.writing.desc: Inscribe the Dao on talismans—unlocks the amphitheatre and transcription arts
science.writing.flavor: Writing uses less ink than pawprints

cultivation.root.san.desc: Three-Element Roots: Standard Qi absorption and +15% breakthrough cost, with +18% same-realm combat power from balanced elemental qi.

cultivation.root.yi.desc: Mutated Root: +80% Qi absorption and -10% breakthrough cost, but specialized single-element qi gives -5% same-realm combat power.
cultivation.root.tian.desc: Single Heavenly Root: +150% Qi absorption and -20% breakthrough cost, but pure single-attribute qi lacks elemental depth (-15% same-realm combat power).

cultivation.artifact.xuantie.label: Black-Iron Greatsword
cultivation.artifact.xuantie.desc: Forged from a rift-beast's spine and black iron. Spirit pressure radiates with every swing. Cultivation gain +8%.
cultivation.artifact.juling.label: Spirit-Gathering Jade
cultivation.artifact.juling.desc: A cultivator's pendant that draws loose ambient qi to its bearer. Cultivation gain +5%.
cultivation.artifact.fengchi.label: Stormwind Pinions
cultivation.artifact.fengchi.desc: Forged from a thunder-roc's plume; one beat crosses a thousand li. While hunting: spirit stones +3/t.
cultivation.artifact.yanghun.label: Soul-Nurturing Wood
cultivation.artifact.yanghun.desc: Ten-thousand-year spiritwood that nourishes the soul and stills the mind. Relic trickle; heart demons slowly recede.
cultivation.artifact.qiankun.label: Qiankun Fan
cultivation.artifact.qiankun.desc: Mountains and rivers painted on its face; one wave reverses the spiritual tide. All production +6%, cultivation +5%.
cultivation.artifact.pangu.label: Pangu Shard
cultivation.artifact.pangu.desc: A fragment of a world-opening treasure, dao-patterns intact. Cultivation +12%, production +6%.
cultivation.artifact.xuding.label: Fallen-Immortal Cauldron
cultivation.artifact.xuding.desc: The vault's crowning relic, warmed ten thousand years in Frostsoul Flame. Cultivation +9%, relic trickle.
cultivation.artifact.yuanci.label: Lodestone Mount
cultivation.artifact.yuanci.desc: A thumb-sized mount of lodestar light — the five phases bow before it. Production +7%, cultivation +8%.
cultivation.msg.pill.zhujidan: Foundation Pill consumed: next breakthrough +50% chance.
cultivation.fate.bottle.label: Dewgather Vial
cultivation.fate.bottle.story: Three months in, your pay is thin and pills never reach an outer disciple. Chasing a white rabbit into the back-mountain rocks, you find a small green vial under old leaves — palm-sized, neither gold nor jade, unnaturally warm, its patterns flowing like clouds.
cultivation.fate.mojuren.label: The Possession Plot
cultivation.fate.mojuren.story: Wen Jiuzhen — Doctor Wen of Rejuvenation Hollow, 'Silver Hand, Buddha Heart' — heals all comers and treats you like a son. He taught you the Nourishing Sutra, sends monthly tonics, and brags his disciple is cultivation stock. If not for the night you carried a wax-sealed letter to his room, you'd have believed it forever.
cultivation.fate.qixuan.label: Mount Cangwu
cultivation.fate.qixuan.story: Leaving Greenpeak, you travel a thousand li to Mount Cangwu, one of Yue's seven sects. Three thousand stone steps climb into cloud; the gate disciple tests your root and strikes a line in the roll: 'Outer disciple — one torn volume of the Verdantwood Sword Art, three mu of spirit field, ten spirit stones a month.' Henceforth, the mortal blades are clouds below the mountain.
cultivation.fate.xuese.label: Blood Forbiddance
cultivation.fate.xuese.story: Qi complete, one step from Foundation — yet the Zhu Ji pill's key herb, the Nine-Bend Spirit Ginseng, grows in bulk in one place only: the Burial-Soul Vale. It opens once a decade; each sect sends Qi disciples in to gather. Spirit herbs everywhere, beasts everywhere — and more dangerous than beasts, people. Three in ten walk out.
cultivation.fate.shijin.label: Gold Devourers
cultivation.fate.shijin.story: On an unnamed reef deep in the Sea you find a nest of ancient insects — Goldbane Grubs. The books rank them among the top strange breeds: ten thousand loose like a golden tide, eating metal and stone; what they pass over turns to dust, and their shed shells make peerless forging stock. Many an ancient power rode a swarm to dominance.
cultivation.fate.yinyue.label: Frostmoon
cultivation.fate.yinyue.story: Fresh from the Ascension tribulation, the bonded treasure you've warmed for years stirs — its sleeping artifact-spirit wakes. She calls herself Silver Moon: silver-haired, a wolf-clan demon cultivator who went to war beside a master ten thousand years dead, and slept in the blade ever since. 'Seas into fields,' she says softly, watching the clouds outside. 'So this is what the world became.'
cultivation.fate.quhun.label: Iron Raiment
cultivation.fate.quhun.story: At Void Refinement you mean to forge a guardian puppet. From a Fallen Star Sea rogue you buy, at weighty cost, an iron corpse refined from an ancient cultivator's remains: flesh incorrupt, iron-armored, baleful aura sealed within — peerless stock for a dao-soldier. The seller says it came off a battlefield in Southwilds, changing hands for centuries.
cultivation.fate.nangong.label: Leng Ningshuang
cultivation.fate.nangong.story: At Fusion your name thunders through Southwilds; Moonreach Palace sends envoys with congratulations. Their leader lifts her veil — a face cold and clear as the moon, a bearing that bows the whole hall — Leng Ningshuang, the sect's once-in-a-millennium genius. She studies you a long moment, something familiar she can't place. You lower your eyes. Some pasts are best left.
cultivation.fate.fenglei.label: Stormwind Pinions
cultivation.fate.fenglei.story: At Great Vehicle, decades of work in ninefold wind and thunder forge a pair of Stormwind Pinions. The day they form, storm-light shakes a hundred li; one beat carries you a thousand li — wanderings and rifts are near or far no more. The utmost escape-speed every cultivator dreams of now grows from your back.
cultivation.fate.xuanguo.label: Profound Sky Fruit
cultivation.fate.xuanguo.story: On the last night of Great-Vehicle perfection, the Primal Dao Fruit you've tended for three thousand years flares — rosy light soaring thirty li through the cloud-sea. The fruit is ripe. Once in ten thousand years; eating it sheds the mortal frame, tempers the dao-foundation flawless, and fifty ancient treasures acknowledge you. Ten thousand years of the path — one step left: the Tribulation.
cultivation.fate.zhangtie.label: A-Yan
cultivation.fate.zhangtie.story: In Rejuvenation Hollow of the Greenpeak Sect you were an unremarkable disciple of Doctor Wen. A-Yan, a village boy who joined the same day, was your only friend — blunt, broad-shouldered, always taking the whip meant for you. Out here, you were each other's only family.
cultivation.fate.zhangtie.trace.hint: Those who see the truth will know that iron corpse one day
cultivation.fate.zhangtie.trace: The lock hits the floor and regret hits with it. No one inside — only a waist-high medicine vat, its walls crusted purple-black, bone grit settling at the bottom. His hatchet still hangs on the wall. You replace the lock with shaking hands. The debt is written down.
cultivation.fate.zhangtie.bide.hint: Survive first — but some smells follow you for life
cultivation.fate.zhangtie.bide: You stand there a while, then go back to bed. 'The less you know, the longer you live,' the jianghu saying goes — yet every rainy night, the reek and the chains return on schedule, like an unsettled account.
cultivation.fate.jinguang.label: Cultivator Bloodglyph
cultivation.fate.jinguang.story: Disaster arrives without warning. Bloodglyph the Wanderer — a rogue cultivator preying on mortals with a single talisman treasure — brings bandits up the Greenpeak mountain. The charm's blood-red light turns every blade; sect masters' swords spark off it. The Sect Master's broken sword still stands in the drill yard, blood running along the cracks to your feet. Mortals cannot stop a cultivator.
cultivation.fate.jinguang.fight.opt: Stand forward and cut him down
cultivation.fate.jinguang.fight.hint: Tonight the mortal world is yours to hold — his relics may hide an ascension token
cultivation.fate.jinguang.fight: Your blade's whistle splits the blood-red light like glass. Bloodglyph dies staring at you as at a monster — who hides a true cultivator among mortals? The fires die by dawn; in his pack you find a token of neither gold nor jade, two ancient seal-script characters: 'Ascension.' A key to the immortal gates, you learn much later.
cultivation.fate.jinguang.flee.opt: Take the vial and slip away
cultivation.fate.jinguang.flee.hint: Live first — but the fire will burn in your dreams for years
cultivation.fate.jinguang.flee: Vial against your chest, you drop down the back cliff in the dark. The blaze paints half the sky red; screams chase you thirty li on the wind. You live — but some nights that fire still walks into your dreams and keeps you sitting up till morning.
cultivation.fate.tainan.label: White Marsh Gathering
cultivation.fate.tainan.story: The White Marsh Valley rogue-cultivator fair runs once in five years — the sectless gather, spending life savings on pages, seeds, beast bones. You go disguised, rough cloth among the crowd, and almost feel mortal again.
cultivation.fate.tainan.sword.hint: It may rhyme with your torn Verdantwood scroll
cultivation.fate.tainan.sword: The fragment's sword-intent hums against your torn scroll — same lineage. On the road home you grasp three tenths more of the way. The old man pockets your stones, smiling like he knew.
cultivation.fate.tainan.seed.hint: Dead seeds? To the Heaven Vial, no herb is truly dead
cultivation.fate.tainan.seed: That night you plant the seeds with a drop of vial-dew. By morning the bed bristles green. If the old man saw his 'dead stock' blooming here, his jaw would drop to the dirt.
cultivation.fate.chuansong.label: Ancient Teleport Array
cultivation.fate.chuansong.story: The war creeps closer; Southwilds has no clean ground left. On the run, deep in a desert-island cave, you find a ruined ancient teleport array — runes beyond present craft, its eye still holding light ten thousand years old. The torn chart names the far side: the Fallen Fallen Star Sea — beasts and fortunes beyond the law of men.
cultivation.fate.chuansong.sail.opt: Spend all you have — sail for the Fallen Star Sea
cultivation.fate.chuansong.sail.hint: Leave Southwilds's debts behind; start over where no one knows your face
cultivation.fate.chuansong.sail: Three months of day-and-night work; the runes wake one by one. Stepping into the eye you glance once toward Southwilds — years, maybe forever, until return. Light spears the cave roof and you are gone, leaving only the tide-hum of the array. The Fallen Fallen Star Sea receives you.
cultivation.fate.chuansong.seal.opt: Map it, seal the cave, stay
cultivation.fate.chuansong.seal.hint: A hidden way out for later — but distant water can't quench a close fire
cultivation.fate.chuansong.seal: You copy the full chart and seal the cave behind wards. A buried way out — if Southwilds ever becomes unlivable, the Sea is your bolt-hole. For now, you still have to survive the war.
cultivation.fate.xutian.label: Fallen-Immortal Vault
cultivation.fate.xutian.story: The Fallen-Immortal Vault — a fallen-immortal vault that opens once in ten thousand years. In the ice cavern of its inner hall the treasures gleam within reach: the Frostsoul Flame, coldest of fires for tempering a dao-foundation; and the Marrowmend Pill, whose sealed fragrance is said to wash marrow and rebuild bone. The wards crack like a spreading web. One breath to take.
cultivation.fate.xutian.flame.hint: A fire for tempering the dao-foundation — once in ten thousand years
cultivation.fate.xutian.flame: You snatch the Frostflame into a jade case; its cold climbs your arm to your spirit platform and fuses into your foundation like thunder. Netherbone's roar fades behind you — flame in hand, the Palace has paid.
cultivation.fate.xutian.pill.hint: Ten thousand years of potency — every heart-demon washed away
cultivation.fate.xutian.pill: The pill melts on your tongue — ten millennia of potency thawing through you like spring through a river. Old wounds, clinging demons, smoothed away inch by inch. One pill: a hundred years of bitter cultivation.
cultivation.fate.erying.label: Second Nascent Soul
cultivation.fate.erying.story: Years ago, for a life-saving art, you split your soul and bred a second Nascent Soul — a 'you' with your own face. At first it was an obedient avatar, walking and risking in your place; but a hundred years on, it has its own tempers, and lately it keeps testing your soul-wards at night. Keeping it is a threat; freeing it is karma; devouring it is a tribulation. Time to settle this.
cultivation.fate.erying.merge.opt: Devour it — take the soul's power
cultivation.fate.erying.merge.hint: Swallow your other self — the foundation swells; something in you goes quiet
cultivation.fate.erying.merge: Devouring it is like swallowing your own shadow — its memories, its grudges, every trick it taught itself in a hundred years, all folded into your foundation. At the end, in the mind-sea, a soft laugh: 'Walk well — take my share too.'
cultivation.fate.erying.release.hint: The world gains a second 'you' — you may meet again, at tribulation
cultivation.fate.erying.release: The seal opens; it stands stunned a long while, then bows deeply: 'Thank you.' It melts into the night and doesn't look back. A hundred years later, at your tribulation, a watcher on the clouds swears a familiar figure took the third bolt for you — then vanished. Your other self came to pay a debt.
cultivation.msg.promoted: Promoted to {0} — sect resources are yours to command.
cultivation.sect.1.label: Greenpeak · Outer Disciple
cultivation.sect.1.desc: A humble beginning on the orthodox path.
cultivation.sect.2.label: Greenpeak · Inner Disciple
cultivation.sect.2.desc: Inner teachings unlocked — the sect's qi is yours to draw on.
cultivation.sect.3.label: Cangwu · Core Disciple
cultivation.sect.3.desc: Mount Cangwu takes all talents; core disciples may enter the lower archive.
cultivation.sect.4.label: Cangwu · Enforcement Elder
cultivation.sect.4.desc: Keeper of discipline — half the mountain's qi answers to you.
cultivation.sect.5.label: Moonreach · Guardian Elder
cultivation.sect.5.desc: Guardian elder of Moonreach Palace — rank and power beyond dispute.
cultivation.sect.6.label: Moonreach · Grand Elder
cultivation.sect.6.desc: Grand elder, the sect's apex — a continent's resources in your palm.
cultivation.fate.mojuren.kill.hint: Kill your master — end the debt and the threat, keep only the sigh
cultivation.fate.mojuren.kill: The soul-battle is silent and vicious. Your Eternal-Spring-forged spirit grinds his remnant to nothing — at the end he stops struggling and sighs, 'A pity.' A pity you weren't his vessel, or a pity for the years? You don't ask. By dawn, Rejuvenation Hollow has lost a doctor, and your eyes have grown a frost that never thaws.
cultivation.fate.mojuren.spare.hint: For three years of teaching, one mercy — a caged tiger bites back
cultivation.fate.mojuren.spare: You win, but can't kill him. For three years of teaching, you seal his remnant into a black-iron artifact, warded thrice. His laugh is cold from inside: 'Good disciple — I'll wait.' And at Core Formation, you remember he did.
cultivation.msg.mojuren.1: The sealed wisp of Doctor Wen whispers: "Boy, your foundation is full of holes." (heart demon grows)
cultivation.msg.mojuren.2: The sealed wisp of Doctor Wen sneers: "This is all you have, and you seek eternity?" (heart demon grows)
cultivation.msg.mojuren.3: The sealed wisp of Doctor Wen sighs: "If I had taken you that night..." (heart demon grows)
cultivation.fate.yinyue.bind.opt: Ask her to stay — bound spirit
cultivation.fate.yinyue.bind.hint: A sentient treasure: +10% to all production — she agrees softly, like moonlight
cultivation.fate.yinyue.bind: 'Ten thousand years waited; one lifetime more is nothing.' Silver Moon smiles and melts into the treasure's light. It answers you like a living thing — though some nights, faint singing drifts out of the blade: wolf-song, or a lullaby.
cultivation.fate.yinyue.free.hint: Ten thousand years of cage ends — the Upper Realm may remember you
cultivation.fate.yinyue.free: The day the seal breaks she rings you three times as a silver rainbow — 'See you in the Upper Realm' — and is gone into cloud. The blade is weaker; you are not sorry. Some debts must be paid; some people should not be kept.
cultivation.fate.feiyu.label: Yue Jinglan
cultivation.fate.feiyu.story: On the drill grounds there's a swordsman, Yue Jinglan — a wild valley nobody who fought into the inner sect on sheer madness, 'Mad Blade Li' they call him. He doesn't know your arts are immortal; he thinks you're another quiet grinder like him, drags you to spar, and buys tavern wine on credit when he loses. In these times, friendship without calculation is rare.
cultivation.fate.feiyu.oath.hint: Immortal and mortal part — when you're famous, he'll be dust
cultivation.fate.feiyu.oath: You kowtow under the moon, swap cups of blood-wine. He laughs and promises three more moves tomorrow. What you can't know: years later, when cultivators ask your name, the one that comes out is his.
cultivation.fate.feiyu.name.hint: 'Yue Jinglan' will do the roaring for you, out in the world
cultivation.fate.feiyu.name: You laugh along, and tuck the name 'Yue Jinglan' next to your heart. Years on, it will thunder across the Fallen Fallen Star Sea's warrants and Southwilds's rolls — while the real man lies long in an unmarked grave.
cultivation.fate.fengyun.label: Green Bamboo Bee-Cloud Swords
cultivation.fate.fengyun.story: At Foundation you undertake a great work: the vial ripens three-thousand-year violet thunder bamboo, three hundred days at the furnace — and yields seventy-two Violetthunder Bamboo Swords. On completion, bees hum all night and the hill glints green — seventy-two swords flying as one will; peers of your rank cannot stand the swarm.
cultivation.fate.chen.label: Gu Qingwu
cultivation.fate.chen.story: The night before the retreat from Cangwu, the wind at the crossing is sharp. Gu Qingwu — the Sect Master's only daughter, the valley's acknowledged pearl — waits there alone for you. Over the years she shielded you from stewards, pressed warm hand-warmers on you, split her rations when your field failed. Now she presses a tightly-sewn pouch on you: dried peach blossoms, three pills she refined herself, and an unsigned letter.
cultivation.fate.chen.dao.hint: The peach rain of Cangwu, thereafter only in dreams
cultivation.fate.chen.dao: You gently push the pouch back and take a single dried blossom: 'The path is long — don't let me waste yours.' She looks at you a long while, then laughs, and the laugh turns wet: 'Of course. It's you.' The crossing empties; the blossom follows the water.
cultivation.fate.chen.love.hint: A bond in wartime — she will stand beside you when the realms reunite
cultivation.fate.chen.love: You take her cold hand: 'If I live past the Fallen Star Sea, I'll come back and marry you.' She laughs through tears and hangs a jade pendant around your neck — a hundred years later you learn it holds a strand of her life-bound essence.
cultivation.fate.dayan.label: Grandmaster Qianji
cultivation.fate.dayan.story: Inside a ruined ancient puppet, a voice answers you. Sealed in the husk is a thousand-year remnant soul — Grand Evolution, in life the peerless master of puppetry and soul-sense, who before dying forged himself into this shell and woke alone in the dark for a millennium. 'Three hundred years,' his voice rasps like rusted iron, 'and you're the first who could hear me.'
cultivation.fate.dayan.disciple.opt: Kneel, and take him as master
cultivation.fate.dayan.disciple.hint: The true Grand Evolution transmission — a teacher's last gift
cultivation.fate.dayan.disciple: You bow three times, old rite. He accepts it, silent a long moment: 'Rise. My last disciple — a junior a thousand years late.' The soul-sense methods pour into you like a river entering the sea. The cheapest bow you ever made.
cultivation.fate.dayan.puppet.opt: Trade only for the puppet art
cultivation.fate.dayan.puppet.hint: No master, no debt — wooden puppets that mine day and night
cultivation.fate.dayan.puppet: 'Fine. Titles of master and disciple stopped mattering to me ages ago.' He gives you the whole art. Three months on, the first iron-wood puppets walk out of the workshop and mine around the clock — your spirit-stone income need never worry again.
cultivation.fate.tihun.label: Soulgorger
cultivation.fate.tihun.story: Hunting beasts in the deep Sea, in a cave like a lone grave you meet a strange beast: ink-black all over but for two green eyes, its cry like an infant's night-wail. The books name it — the Soulgorger beast, bane of ghosts and souls, whose roar routs a hundred wraiths. It studies your soul a moment, then comes over and rubs your palm.
cultivation.fate.yuanyao.label: Yuan Yao
cultivation.fate.yuanyao.story: Among letters from old Fallen Star Sea friends comes a slender-handed note — Shen Qingheng, a woman cultivator you met a few times back then, now caught in a storm over a treasure: a few islands' worth of hunters on her trail. She asks for nothing. Only: 'It's been years since the Sea — are you well, old friend?' A blot of ink spreads at the signature like an unshed tear.
cultivation.fate.yuanyao.aid.opt: Go — settle the hunt for her
cultivation.fate.yuanyao.aid.hint: Debts among cultivators are hardest to repay — she'll remember
cultivation.fate.yuanyao.aid: You arrive on the tide and end the bounty in three days. She bows deeply on the reef and says nothing — but ever after, at every great breakthrough of yours, a message reading only 'Take care' arrives on time.
cultivation.fate.yuanyao.bond.opt: Stand beside her — as a true friend
cultivation.fate.yuanyao.bond.hint: Coal in the snow — the Sea gains a back you can guard; her letters will come
cultivation.fate.yuanyao.bond: 'Between us, no thanks.' You sit out the night on the reef, trading Fallen Star Sea gossip for Southwilds peach blossoms. At parting she gives you a message talisman: 'The Sea is wide — it's good to have someone to talk to.' Ever since, greetings from far waters reach your cave.
cultivation.fate.xugu.label: Netherbone
cultivation.fate.xugu.story: Deep in a desert-island cave mansion, a jade-white skeleton opens its eyes — Netherbone, a devil-dao colossus of the Fallen Star Sea ten thousand years gone, whose remnant clings to the bones. Unhurried, he dusts his ribs: 'That you reached this place, young friend, is fate.' The smile is warm; the eyes are colder than the skull. Ten-thousand-year ghosts burn no cheap oil.
cultivation.fate.xugu.ally.hint: Two liars walking together — the day the hoard opens, the account falls due
cultivation.fate.xugu.ally: You clasp hands as allies, all smiles, each privately ordering the other's coffin. Months on, his knowledge genuinely opens your eyes — but every night you can feel the gaze of a thing appraising prey, sticky on your back.
cultivation.fate.xugu.slay.opt: Strike first while his soul is weak
cultivation.fate.xugu.slay.hint: A ten-thousand-year remnant is still a remnant — take his hoard and end it
cultivation.fate.xugu.slay: Flame blooms in your palm; his laugh stops short: 'Ruthless little—' 'As you were.' The jade bones crumble; beneath his skull-pillow you find a storage ring — slim on stones, but holding half a sea chart with the Fallen-Immortal Vault marked clear.
cultivation.msg.xugu.gift: Netherbone sends a relic: "Share and share alike, little friend." (relic +{0})
cultivation.msg.xugu.skim: Some of your spirit stones are gone — a note in Netherbone's hand: "Borrowed, will repay." (spirit stones -{0})
cultivation.fate.qingyuan.label: the Verdantwood Patriarch
cultivation.fate.qingyuan.story: Deep in the Featherfolk warrens's abyss you meet a guttering remnant soul — the Verdantwood Patriarch, founder of the Verdantwood Sword Art, the source of your whole blade-path. Watching you wield his art for thirty years, the old swordmaster shows a remnant's contentment: 'Three thousand years, and at last a worthy bearer.' Knowing his time is short, he pours his lifetime of sword-truth into you.
cultivation.fate.xiedao.label: Old Bronze-Shell
cultivation.fate.xiedao.story: A gilded bronze-shell puppet of unknown origin arrives at your door, calling itself Old Bronze-Shell — gilded carapace, wind-quick, taciturn and unreadably deep. It works for one payment only: violet thunder bamboo. You test it once — it clears a century of backlog overnight, with an efficiency that is almost eerie.
cultivation.guide.hut: Build a thatched hut — a quiet cell that yields cultivation on its own
cultivation.guide.field: Open a spirit field — spirit grain trickles in to fuel wood refinement
cultivation.fate.zhangtie.wary.hint: Swap the doctor's tonics for plain water
cultivation.fate.zhangtie.wary: You go back quietly. From the next month on, his 'fortifying powder' gets poured into the ravine as water. If he's kind, you waste some herbs; if not — your life rides on this suspicion.
cultivation.fate.feiyu.decline.hint: A cultivator needs no mortal ties — true, and heavy
cultivation.fate.feiyu.decline: You start pleading illness. He comes three times; the last, he leaves half a jar at your door and goes, scratching his head. No more shouting outside the gate. The first lesson of cultivation is letting go.
cultivation.fate.tainan.wine.opt: Buy the wine — and the stories
cultivation.fate.tainan.wine.hint: A rogue's mouth holds real news — first word of the Fallen Fallen Star Sea
cultivation.fate.tainan.wine: Three bowls in, the stories pour: 'The Fallen Fallen Star Sea, they say — beast cores spent like stones! Few who crossed came back; but those who did came back kings.' You quietly write the name on your heart.
cultivation.fate.chen.forget.opt: Say nothing — let the river take it
cultivation.fate.chen.forget.hint: The cleanest goodbye — and the deepest cut
cultivation.fate.chen.forget: You don't take the pouch. You don't speak. When the morning fog lifts the crossing is empty; one blossom on the stone she stood on, blown into the water. You tell yourself it was the right ending — and for centuries after, avoid every place where peach trees bloom.
cultivation.fate.erying.seal.hint: Cold laughter in the ward every night — some debts only grow
cultivation.fate.erying.seal: You lay twelve stronger wards. Deep in the seal it laughs low: 'We will meet again.' You know you will. And that day's accounting will be harder than this one.

achievements.tribulation.desc: Heaven's lightning could not fell you; ascension beckons.

cultivation.omen.ziqi: Purple qi drifts in from the east; auspicious clouds gather above your abode—heaven favors you.
cultivation.omen.ziqi.b: Violet haze rolls across the eastern sky, spirit-clouds coiling like a dragon. A most fortunate sign.
cultivation.omen.lingchao: A tide of spiritual energy wells up around your abode; the world's qi converges here.
cultivation.omen.lingchao.b: The earth-veins murmur like surf; mist seeps from the stone and wets your sleeve.
cultivation.omen.xinmo: A whisper rises in your heart: 'This is far enough. Why reach further?' Your dao-heart wavers.
cultivation.omen.xinmo.b: Deep in your sea of mind, an old friend's voice calls your name. You turn—only candlelight flickers.
cultivation.omen.hushen: A sect elder arrives to guard your rite, stilling the restless energies on every side.
cultivation.omen.hushen.b: Your sect-brothers weave a warding array; light closes over the abode like a bell.
cultivation.omen.gongming: Your opened spirit vein resonates with the abode's qi; the spring hums in time with your breath.
cultivation.omen.gongming.b: The vein's breathing falls into step with your circulation, and spirit qi pours back in.
cultivation.omen.pohou: Fine cracks already vein the barrier—fail or not, each crack remembers the way.
cultivation.omen.pohou.b: On the brink of breaking, you feel a hidden shell inside your meridians: break it, and the road is clear.
cultivation.omen.dunwu: Your sea of mind snaps into clarity; a thousand mysteries hang in view like morning stars. Now or never!
cultivation.omen.dunwu.b: A flash of insight—for an instant you glimpse a corner of the Great Dao. A perfect moment to ascend.
cultivation.omen.zouhuo: Your qi reverses course; your chest takes an invisible blow—deviation looms!
cultivation.omen.zouhuo.b: Your meridians burn and your qi scatters into chaos. To press on now invites disaster.
cultivation.msg.fail.1: The push for {0} fails! Torn meridians invite the heart-demon in (+{1})—yet you've traced the barrier's veins now. Next time comes easier.
cultivation.msg.fail.2: Your qi scatters three inches from the gate. {0} stands unreached and demons stir (+{1})—but defeat taught you its shape.
cultivation.msg.fail.3: A breath of true qi nearly dissipates into your limbs. The wall of {0} holds; demons grow (+{1})—still, each failure maps the gate more clearly.
cultivation.msg.fail.zouhuo: Deviation! Your qi surges backward and you cough blood. The assault on {0} ends in ruin—demons surge (+{1}), cultivation scatters. Rest and purge before you try again.
cultivation.msg.breakthrough.perfect: A flawless breakthrough! You enter {0} with an immaculate foundation and a lucid mind—your heart-demons are swept away.

stats.jianghu.offline: The board does not answer — backend offline (mock-kgnet not running)
cultivation.msg.pill.maxed: The elixir power already peaks — save the Foundation Pill for the next attempt.
cultivation.msg.pill.clean: Your mind is already clear — no need for a Clarity Pill.
cultivation.fate.mojuren.story2: In his candlelit study, hunting a prescription, you find a manual written in blood — the Form-Seizing Codex. Mastered, it lets a soul seize a young cultivator's body and live again; the ideal vessel: 'a spiritually-rooted youth of shallow cultivation.' You can't steady your hands enough to light the lamp. Three years of fatherly care — watering a herb.
cultivation.fate.xuese.story2: No sun or moon in the valley. On the third dusk, following a herb-scent, you reach Darkflood Mere and walk into a fight: a silver-robed woman bound at the pond's heart by a black flood-drake, hair loose, protective light thin as rice paper. The jade at her waist marks Moonreach Palace — first of the seven — inner disciple, Leng Ningshuang. Her eyes flick to you once, then back to the beast.
cultivation.fate.xuese.jiao.opt: Aid her — kill the dragon together
cultivation.fate.xuese.jiao.hint: Split the spoils — and she will remember this glance (meet Leng Ningshuang)
cultivation.fate.xuese.jiao: You burst out — three talismans seal its eyes, her sword reads the opening and takes the throat. Sharing spoils, she lifts a corner of her veil — a face cold and clear as the moon — and nods: 'Leng Ningshuang of Moonreach Palace. I'll remember.' A chance meeting, you think. You don't know that glance takes a thousand years to repay.
cultivation.fate.xuese.lurk.hint: If she dies the herbs are all yours; if she lives — no one knows you watched
cultivation.fate.xuese.lurk: Behind the rocks you watch her fight free, wounded, and vanish — then slip down and dig up the ginseng plus seven or eight century herbs. Loaded, you tell yourself: only the living get to argue morality. Still, that bloodied silver figure visits your dreams now and then.
cultivation.fate.qixuan.story.token: At Cangwu's gate you present the Ascension Token taken from Bloodglyph's relics. The gate disciple's face changes; half an hour later a Foundation steward leads you in himself: 'Token-bearers enter the inner sect.' So that night's work pays out here: the full Sword Art, field and cave estate, and weight in the eyes of your peers.
cultivation.fate.zhengmo.label: The War of Righteous and Demonic
cultivation.fate.zhengmo.story: Peace lasted so long everyone forgot the Devil Dao's six sects sharpening knives beyond the border. Late autumn — beacons ignite overnight. The Righteous-Devil War: devil-fire floods Yue, the seven sects lose battle after battle. Cangwu empties its strength and still loses ground; the villages below burn to white ground, and refugees' cries climb the mountain road all the way to the summit.
cultivation.fate.zhengmo.story2: The elders' council sits three days and reaches one word: 'seed.' The elite withdraw first; the old and weak hold the pass. You are not on the withdrawal list — a new Core with no faction, exactly the sort left behind to buy hours with a body.
cultivation.fate.zhengmo.rear.opt: Stay — hold the pass a while
cultivation.fate.zhengmo.rear.hint: Buy the sect its thread of life — the survivors will know who held the ridge
cultivation.fate.zhengmo.rear: You stay. When the devil-fire comes you and a few dozen volunteers hold the pass — talismans, then swords, then fists. Dawn finds the valley empty and you walking out of a corpse-hill, soaked in blood. No one behind you calls the factionless Core cultivator small again.
cultivation.fate.zhengmo.slip.hint: Live first — but 'deserter' trails your name for years
cultivation.fate.zhengmo.slip: In the thick of the crowd you change to a rogue's clothes and go. Cangwu burns three days behind you; you never look back. On this road, only the living get to argue right and wrong — but sometimes, peach blossoms still find you.
cultivation.fate.duoshi.label: The Remnant Soul Strikes Back
cultivation.fate.duoshi.story: At the tightest moment of Core Formation, the black-iron artifact on your chest goes scalding — you almost forgot what it holds. Wen Jiuzhen's remnant erupts from its cage, years of venom behind it, lunging for your violet palace: 'Good disciple — I told you. Your body. Lend it.' He has waited a whole realm for this.
cultivation.fate.duoshi.story2: Souls grapple in the mind-sea, crueller than any blade. His soul-force is withered but venomous, chewing at your reason where heart-demons breed; yours is at Core-strength but dares not strike full — lest it crack your newborn core. In the dark he talks, almost tender: the day he took you in was for your root; but the three years' teaching was not all false.
cultivation.fate.duoshi.burn.hint: Burn the last of him — the account closes tonight
cultivation.fate.duoshi.burn: In soul-fire like southern brilliance the remnant curls to ash. At the very end he stops cursing and says something soft — 'Nourishing Sutra, ninth layer,' or only a sigh. You open your eyes to snow at the window. There is no more Doctor Wen.
cultivation.fate.duoshi.tame.hint: He cannot die — but his lifetime of alchemy can serve you
cultivation.fate.duoshi.tame: You re-seal the shattered soul, triple-warded, branded with a master-servant pact. He accepts the loss: 'So be it… my lifetime of medicine and pill-lore — take it as a keepsake.' Henceforth your pill-path has a ghost guide — his whole art, prolonging him the only way left.
cultivation.fate.chuansong.story2: Repairs need time, and the devil-fire is only a few hundred li off. Surf thunders outside; runes flicker within. The array is the only road out — and a road of no return: what waits on the far side no one promises. Go, or stay?
cultivation.fate.yinyue.story2: Her stay or go is a hard question. Bound, the treasure outthinks your old limits, answering thought like a limb; but the thirst for freedom in her eyes is plain — the same look you wore once, clutching a little vial.
cultivation.fate.quhun.story.known: At Void Refinement you mean to forge a guardian puppet. From a Fallen Star Sea rogue you buy, at weighty cost, an iron corpse refined from an ancient cultivator's remains. The seller says it came out of Southwilds — and your heart sinks without cause. Centuries ago, Rejuvenation Hollow, a midnight medicine vat, chains dragged over stone… You press the cold faceplate a long time without lifting it.
cultivation.fate.quhun.story2: At the last moment before the rites begin, you lift the faceplate —
cultivation.fate.quhun.bury.hint: Into the earth with a name — A-Yan, not a dao-soldier
cultivation.fate.quhun.bury: On a nameless ridge you raise a stone with four characters: 'Old Friend A-Yan.' Covering the earth, you remember an evening long ago — three lashes he took for you, grinning through it. The mountain keeps his bones. May his next life never see a sect gate.
cultivation.fate.quhun.wield.opt: Refine him — the puppet Iron Raiment
cultivation.fate.quhun.wield.hint: Your old friend's body guards you now, tireless — another way to live
cultivation.fate.quhun.wield: The talisman sets; the corpse opens its eyes — no light in them, only dead loyalty. You give him a new name: Iron Raiment. 'Guard me,' you say, stroking the cold iron, soft as if to yourself. 'This time — let me protect you.'
cultivation.fate.xutian.story.betray: The inner hall's ice cavern, the hoard within reach — and as the wards crack, the hairs on your neck rise. Netherbone sheds his mild face at last: 'Young friend — the treasures are mine. Your body is mine as well.' A ten-thousand-year strike lands silent at your back. You always knew he'd turn; you didn't think he'd pick the one breath you couldn't spare.
cultivation.fate.xutian.story2: Treasure-light floods the cavern as the wards collapse — ten-thousand-year ice rains from the vault. Frostflame and pill blaze side by side, and you have one breath: take the flame and your foundation is tempered for ages; take the pill and every old wound and heart-demon washes clean. The ceiling is already coming down.
cultivation.fate.xutian.tihun.hint: Predator meets bane — let him be devoured; the whole hoard is yours
cultivation.fate.xutian.tihun: The moment the Soulgorger leaves its case, Netherbone's grin freezes. A single infant-wail from the green-eyed beast and his soul rips off your arm like water down a throat — 'Young friend, spare—' The plea ends in the beast's mouth. Silence; the hoard is yours. Ten-thousand-year Netherbone — dessert.
cultivation.fate.xutian.flame.opt.betray: Fight while you take the Frostflame
cultivation.fate.xutian.flame.hint.betra: Snatch it under fire — cultivation gain +6%
cultivation.fate.xutian.flame.betray: Fighting as you retreat, you wheel back and bottle the Deepblue Iceflame. Netherbone's curses are cut off by the closing gate — the pale blue wisp at your fingertips is a trump card snatched from a devil's teeth.
cultivation.fate.xutian.pill.opt.betray: Fight while you take the pill
cultivation.fate.xutian.pill.hint.betray: Live to fight another day — heart demon -40
cultivation.fate.xutian.pill.betray: You do not linger — seize the Heavenmending Pill and flee on your light. Behind you, the old devil roars — but ten thousand years of medicine melt on your tongue, and the whole ordeal fades like waking from a dream.
cultivation.fate.nangong.story.met: At Fusion your name thunders through Southwilds; Moonreach Palace sends envoys. Their leader lifts her veil — and you both freeze. The Burial-Soul Vale, the Darkflood Mere: she held that glance for a thousand years. 'So it's you,' she says, unreadable. Around the hall, guests wonder why two Fusion powers are staring so long.
cultivation.fate.nangong.story.met_guilt: At Fusion your name thunders through Southwilds; Moonreach Palace sends envoys. Their leader lifts her veil — and you freeze. The Burial-Soul Vale, the Darkflood Mere: you held that glance for a thousand years too. Her gaze moves past you to Gu Qingwu at your side, pauses — and she inclines her head, saying nothing. That moment's grace outweighs any accusation.
cultivation.fate.nangong.story2: After the banquet she stands alone on the steps, watching snow. You walk over and stop three paces off. A thousand years flows quietly between two Fusion cultivators — some words don't need saying; some people only need one more snow watched side by side.
cultivation.fate.erying.story2: Tonight it's here again. Outside the seal, your own face presses close, smiling: 'We are one flesh — why draw lines? Your Dao — why should you alone get to walk it?' Its voice is your voice; and the grievance in its eyes is exactly the one you carried once.
cultivation.fate.xuanguo.story.twin: The night the Heavenfruit ripens, a sword-light descends outside your cave. A visitor with your own eyebrows and eyes stands under the moon — he has returned. 'Heard you are crossing the tribulation. Came to see.' The second infant keeps you company under the stars all night, and leaves saying only: 'Don't die.'
cultivation.fate.xuanguo.story.love: The night the Heavenfruit ripens, you go alone to the old site of Mount Cangwu. The peach blossoms fell centuries ago; you sit until dawn before a small memorial tablet — Qiaoqian, one last threshold. If I make it through... but then, we cultivators do not believe in next lives.
cultivation.fate.xuanguo.story.bond: The night the Heavenfruit ripens, a sword-light arrives from the Moonshadow Sect. Leng Ningshuang stands in your courtyard and offers a guardian jade: 'On the day of your tribulation, I will wait beyond the platform.' — One glance at Inkdragon Pool, kept for a thousand years.
cultivation.fate.xuanguo.story2: That night you sit alone on the peak. Looking back over this life — the medicine smell of Greenpeak, the cellar in Rejuvenation, that glance by the flood pond, the peach rain of Cangwu, ten thousand li of the Fallen Star Sea's waves… old friends scattered, debts settled, all folded into the dawn-colored dao-fruit in your core. Thunder is already brewing. The last leap begins.
cultivation.chronicle.title: Chronicle of the Immortal Path · {0} entries
cultivation.msg.mojuren.tame: From deep in the artifact, the old ghost drawls: 'Ease the furnace flame by three parts today.'
cultivation.msg.erying.1: A familiar sneer drifts from the depths of the seal: 'We are one — can you truly seal me?'
cultivation.msg.erying.2: In the deep of night, laughter sounds again at the edge of your mind. You reinforce the seal once more; the laughter remains.
cultivation.msg.yuanyao.1: A message-jade arrives from Shen Qingheng: the Fallen Star Sea is calm, and her senior sister's soul has firmed again.
cultivation.msg.yuanyao.2: A letter arrives across the seas: Shen Qingheng found some fortune and keeps an eye on the Fallen Star Sea for you.
cultivation.dream.mojuren: Nightmare: a rainy night, a medicine vat, and eyes opening in the dark. 'Good disciple...' You wake drenched in cold sweat.
cultivation.dream.zhangtie: Nightmare: the chains in the cellar are rattling again. Following the sound, you find an honest face floating in the medicine vat.
cultivation.dream.chen: Nightmare: the wind is strong at the ferry, her sleeves fluttering. You try to call out to her, but your throat makes no sound.
cultivation.dream.erying: Nightmare: the figure in the mirror smiles back at you, and the smile slowly turns strange.
cultivation.dream.xugu: Nightmare: the jade-white skeleton sits on your meditation cushion, gently counting your spirit stones: 'Little friend, those who see get a share.'
cultivation.dream.path: Nightmare: at the end of the immortal path stands a figure. You approach — it is you, white-haired.
cultivation.fate.zhangtie.story2: Half a month ago A-Yan 'went home.' Doctor Wen said it lightly — full severance, packed bags. But you remembered him swearing he wouldn't go home this year, not until he'd saved enough for his mother's cure. Since then, twice at midnight, you've smelled a cloying medicinal reek from the cellar — and heard chains dragged across stone, slow and heavy, like something turning over in the dark.
cultivation.fate.zhangtie.story3: Tonight the smell is back. You stand at the cellar mouth, palm on the cold copper lock. Where did A-Yan go? What's down there? What's behind the good doctor's kind face? Open this door and there is no going back to innocence — but the boy who took your whippings may be lying down there.
cultivation.fate.bottle.story2: You leave it on the windowsill. At dawn a drop of emerald dew wells inside its lip and falls onto a wilted sprout in the crack — before your eyes it branches, leafs, flowers, living a year in a tea's time. You clutch the vial till your knuckles whiten: a poor man's son finally holds something no one else has.
cultivation.fate.feiyu.story2: Tonight he vaults your wall with two jugs of cheap wine: 'Han, when my blade is famous across Yue, you'll be in the crowd to vouch for me!' His eyes shine like stars — a mortal who'll never know what he lacks. And you think: this name deserves to be remembered.
cultivation.fate.mojuren.story3: That night he enters with his familiar scent of herbs; the candle dies with no wind. The kind face stretches into another shape. 'Good disciple — this body of mine hasn't many years left. Yours will do nicely.' A soul like ink pours from his brow into your sea of consciousness. The account between master and pupil comes due.
cultivation.fate.jinguang.story2: Except that you are no longer fully mortal. Bloodglyph is torching the scripture hall, laughing inside his golden shell, blind to the figure behind him. Your hand finds the little sword you've fed for three years — kill him and hundreds live; melt into the crowd and you'll still walk out alive. Only this: retreat today, and every later wall you meet will have tonight's face.
cultivation.fate.xuese.story3: Strike, or watch? The dragon's strength could pulp you; yet the five-hundred-year ginseng glints below the pond — and if she dies, you are next. The water churns; the dragon's slit pupils are already turning your way.
cultivation.fate.qixuan.story2: Life in the valley is spare and steady — tending the field by day, grinding the sword art by night, breathing with the mountain's insects. Sometimes Rejuvenation's medicine smell, the cellar's chains, that rainy-night study come back. Past is past. The road under your feet now is a true immortal path.
cultivation.fate.tainan.story2: At a one-armed veteran's stall you stop. Three goods: a half-burnt fragment of a sword manual, a pouch of shriveled herb seeds, a jug of rough wine. The old man squints: 'New face. Pick one.' Your stones cover one.
cultivation.fate.fengyun.story2: Thereafter the world has fewer teeth. The swarm parts beasts; common robbers turn at your first sword-light. Stroking the sword-pill in your palm you finally understand Wen Jiuzhen's hunger — power itself is the sweetest sound there is.
cultivation.fate.zhengmo.story3: The night before retreat, the mountain rustles with packing. Some kneel to their masters, some weep into the spirit fields, and some — like you — stand in the wind over the fires below, doing cold arithmetic: staying is near-certain death; slipping away is a thread of life. No one sleeps tonight.
cultivation.fate.duoshi.story3: 'Master.' Your voice rings level through the mind-sea. 'You're right — this body is fine cultivation stock. Which is why you can't have it.' The remnant falters — and you strike.
cultivation.fate.chen.story2: 'Safe travels, cultivator.' She turns to go, stops, and says with her back to you: 'When the spirit field burned and you took the blame for me… I knew then.' Wind takes her hair. With Southwilds burning and the road endless, some words unspoken tonight may never be said.
cultivation.fate.shijin.story2: Raising them is painstaking — feeding, splitting the nest, taming. But when the first wave folds into a small gold cloud in your palm, you know the cost was right: your cave gains its most loyal guards, your enemies a most horrible way to die.
cultivation.fate.dayan.story2: His terms are simple: he teaches you the Grand Evolution Art of soul-sense and the puppet way; you find him a vessel to lodge in — or see him off on his last journey. 'I taught everyone everything in my life,' the remnant says, 'except how to die.' In his laugh you can't tell detachment from grief.
cultivation.fate.tihun.story2: To befriend a Soulgorger is outrageous luck — devil-cultivators and ghost-arts bow to you now, and the heart-demon phantoms of your breakthroughs are mere meals to it. Yet the beast's origin is strange; the nameless grave deeper in the cave, you never dare to dig. Some secrets are better left on the seafloor.
cultivation.fate.yuanyao.story2: The old days surface: a bright, proud Foundation cultivator who once fed herself to a devil to save her senior sister. Centuries on, she is still standing in the wind and blades. Help, or don't?
cultivation.fate.quhun.story2.known: The plate slides away and your blood runs cold. Under the iron is A-Yan's honest face — almost as it was, only it will never smile again. The vat in the cellar, Wen Jiuzhen's art, the erased body… so this is where he went. He was here all along.
cultivation.fate.quhun.story3: The refining array is set. The soul-binding talisman flares in your fingers, dies, flares again — inside this shell once lived a boy who took your whippings. Refine him, and he's your most loyal soldier; bury him, and he's your friend forever. Refine — or bury?
cultivation.fate.xugu.story2: He proposes a hunt: the inner halls of the Fallen-Immortal Vault hold ancient hoards, warded so deep that two must work as one. 'Split even — what say you?' The terms are watertight. Deal with the tiger — or flip the table now?
cultivation.fate.xutian.story2.betray: Treasure-light floods the cavern. You twist aside from the killing blow, but a soul-thread of his possession art is already cold around your right arm. Frostflame and pill lie paces away — treasure first, or your life?
cultivation.fate.xutian.story3: The flame’s ghost-light, the pill’s scent, the collapsing cavern — all of it crowds into a single instant. Centuries taught you to stake your life on one thought. So — which thought?
cultivation.fate.nangong.story3: For a hundred years after, her sword-messages fall into your cave now and then — a point of dao, or just 'snow over the Fallen Star Sea.' The dao-heart has an anchor; heart-demons cannot get a hold. A thousand years of cultivation suddenly has somewhere to go.
cultivation.fate.qingyuan.story2: The transmission lasts forty-nine days. As the last intent threads into your mind-sea, his soul is already nearly gone: 'The art is yours. Walk it further than I did.' the Verdantwood Patriarch scatters into green light like silent snow. 'Hear the Way at dawn; die content at dusk' — you bow to the abyss, deep and long.
cultivation.fate.erying.story3: It's not wrong — it is your part: your fear, your ambition, the face you wouldn't admit. Devour it and you sever an arm; free it and you loose a tiger. Inside and outside the seal, two 'yous' regard each other across a film of light, like a mirror.
cultivation.fate.fenglei.story2: From then on, morning on the blue sea, dusk on the dark parasol-tree. The boy who once gasped up the Greenpeak' mountain path now covers rivers and mountains between wingbeats — the further the road, the more you learn to look back.
cultivation.fate.xiedao.story2: 'A hundred roots of thunder bamboo — a hundred years of my work.' The Daoist spreads its claws, expressionless. Nothing in this world comes free — but its work is truly easy on the mind. What you keep is a riddle; what you wield is a blade.
cultivation.fate.xuanguo.story2.bond: That night a sword-light comes from Moonreach. Leng Ningshuang stands in your court and holds out a protective jade: 'On tribulation day, I'll wait beyond the dais.' One glance by a flood pond a thousand years ago — and she kept it this long. You take the jade; the gathering storm-clouds look less terrible.
cultivation.fate.xuanguo.story2.love: The night before, you go alone to old Cangwu. The gates hold strangers now; only the peach trees bloom as they did. You sit at her tablet till dawn and leave a strand of the fruit's light at the stone — Qiaoqian, the last wall. If I pass it… but cultivators don't believe in next lives.
cultivation.fate.xuanguo.story2.twin: That night a sword-light lands outside your cave. A visitor with your own face stands hands-clasped under the moon — he's back. 'Heard you're taking the Tribulation. Came to watch.' Your second self sits out the stars with you, and leaving, says only: 'Don't die.' The other you has come this far too.
cultivation.fate.xuanguo.story3: The rosy light fades; the sky's depth rumbles once. You brush dew off your robe and walk toward the tribulation dais. Ten thousand years of seeking, all for this breath — pass or fail, every choice on the road was already the answer.

help.title: Cultivation Manual
help.intro: Path Guidance walks you through the opening. This manual explains each system — consult it whenever you stall.
help.s.start.b1: Click 'Gather Spirit Grain' — it fuels building and wood refinement.
help.s.start.b2: At 10 grain, build a Spirit Field: grain then trickles in on its own.
help.s.start.b3: 'Refine Spirit Wood' turns 100 grain into 1 wood; with 2 wood, raise a Thatched Hut.
help.s.start.b4: The hut is a quiet cell that yields cultivation; when you have enough, open the Realm tab and Breakthrough.
help.s.start.b5: At Qi Refining II the guide leads you onward — wander, seclude, run rifts.
help.s.realm.b1: Nine realms: Qi Refining, Foundation, Golden Core, Nascent Soul, Spirit Severing, Void Refining, Body Integration, Mahayana, Tribulation.
help.s.realm.b2: Each layer costs cultivation; past Qi Refining, breakthroughs can fail — failure costs nerve, never the realm.
help.s.realm.b3: Spirit root is rolled at birth: single Heavenly Roots cultivate fast with lower breakthrough costs but lower same-realm combat power; multi-element Mixed/Triple Roots pay more to break through but wield much higher same-realm combat power.
help.s.realm.b4: Cultivation income: hut trickle, wander fortunes, rift loot, pills, seclusion.
help.s.realm.b5: Every realm raises production and combat power alike — realm is everything.
help.s.action.b1: Wander: random fortunes — stones, herbs, fate events, occasional ambushes; slay the ambusher for loot.
help.s.action.b2: Seclusion: +60% cultivation, -90% mundane output — toggle before a hard breakthrough.
help.s.action.b3: Minor Rift: guaranteed cultivation plus a 30% rift-key drop.
help.s.action.b4: Greater Rift: spend a key per floor climbed; deeper pays more and drops artifacts.
help.s.action.b5: All four share one breath — after any trial, rest a moment.
help.s.power.b1: Power comes from realm and artifacts — measure yourself before deep rift floors.
help.s.power.b2: Artifacts drop only in the Greater Rift; duplicates rank up, maxed ones fuse into relics.
help.s.power.b3: Losing a fight costs the key, never your life.
help.s.eco.b1: Grain → wood → buildings: the Bonfire tab is the foundation of stone and cultivation income.
help.s.eco.b2: Spirit veins (Foundation): a permanent cultivation multiplier — buy early when spirit stones allow.
help.s.eco.b3: Sects (Foundation): promote as soon as your realm allows — huge cultivation boosts.
help.s.eco.b4: Pills: Qingxin purges heart demons, Zhuji adds breakthrough odds, Juqi boosts cultivation for a time.
help.s.fate.b1: Wandering brings fate events — each choice is written into your chronicle.
help.s.fate.b2: Some choices open story arcs, others grant instant boons; follow your heart — few are strictly wrong.
help.s.life.b1: Lifespan grows with realm; when it runs out, you pass away in meditation.
help.s.life.b2: Passing means reincarnation: cultivation is lost, karma remains — blessings for the next life.
help.s.life.b3: Rebirth rerolls your spirit root; karma buys permanent boons at the reincarnation screen.
help.s.cloud.b1: Autosaves locally every 30 seconds; export/import text saves under Options.
help.s.cloud.b2: Log in for cloud saves and shareable preview pages.
help.s.cloud.b3: The Jianghu leaderboard: optionally submit your realm to compare with fellow cultivators.
help.s.faq.b1: Button greyed out? Check the resource column — red means missing; or you're resting between trials.
help.s.faq.b2: Breakthrough failed? Heart demon rises and suppresses the next attempt — wait it out or take a Qingxin pill.
help.s.faq.b3: Not sure what to do? Read Path Guidance — usually it's time to break through or run a rift.
help.s.faq.b4: Does progress persist after closing? Yes — local autosave; reopen and continue.
